name: chromium-volume-booster
description: A modular Chrome MV3 volume booster extension built with TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run i18n:generate && npm run i18n:check && npm run i18n:audit && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-registered-content-scripts.mjs
scripts.test: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:mutate: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && stryker run
scripts.test:mutate:changed: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && node scripts/stryker-changed.mjs
scripts.test:mutate:file: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && node scripts/stryker-file.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run i18n:generate && node scripts/build-faust-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run i18n:check && npm run i18n:audit && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
